name: an_offer_you_cant_refuse_counters_the_spell_and_its_controller_gets_two_treasures
notes: Printed: 'Counter target noncreature spell. Its controller creates two Treasure tokens.' Seat 1 casts Giant Growth (a noncreature spell) at its own Bear; seat 0 answers with An Offer You Can't Refuse. Giant Growth is countered (graveyard, the Bear stays 2/2) and seat 1 - the countered spell's controller, not the caster of the Offer - creates two Treasure tokens. Seat 1 has no other mana: it casts two more Giant Growths with the Treasure mana alone (Bear 8/8), which works only if seat 1 controls both Treasures; both are sacrificed, none is left (so there were exactly two, and seat 0 got none). Seat 0's pool is spent.
